SLUG = 'universal-record-api-signature'
ROUTES = [
    ("GET", "/records/" + SLUG + "/JAH-URAP-000001", "read one record"),
    ("GET", "/records/" + SLUG, "list records, page by page"),
    ("GET", "/records/" + SLUG + "?subject=search", "search records by field"),
    ("POST", "/records/" + SLUG, "create a record"),
    ("PUT", "/records/" + SLUG + "/JAH-URAP-000001", "change a record"),
    ("DELETE", "/records/" + SLUG + "/JAH-URAP-000001", "mark a record withdrawn"),
]

"""Routing demo for the Universal Record API record 24: The Universal Record API Field Guide Index.
A small working router: resolves a method and address to an action."""
import hashlib
SLUG = 'universal-record-api-signature'
ROUTES = [
    ("GET", "/records/" + SLUG + "/JAH-URAP-000001", "read one record"),
    ("GET", "/records/" + SLUG, "list records, page by page"),
    ("GET", "/records/" + SLUG + "?subject=search", "search records by field"),
    ("POST", "/records/" + SLUG, "create a record"),
    ("PUT", "/records/" + SLUG + "/JAH-URAP-000001", "change a record"),
    ("DELETE", "/records/" + SLUG + "/JAH-URAP-000001", "mark a record withdrawn"),
]
def route(method, path):
    for m, p, action in ROUTES:
        if m == method and p == path:
            return action
    base = path.split("?")[0]
    for m, p, action in ROUTES:
        if m == method and p.split("?")[0] == base and "?" not in p:
            return action
    return "error 404: no such endpoint"
print("Universal Record API routing demo — record 24: The Universal Record API Field Guide Index")
results = []
for m, p, want in ROUTES:
    got = route(m, p)
    results.append(got)
    print("  %s %s -> %s" % (m, p, got))
print("Routes resolved: %d" % len(ROUTES))
h = hashlib.sha256(("|".join(results)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: every route resolves to its action — " + ("pass" if all(route(m, p) == w for m, p, w in ROUTES) else "fail"))
print("Test: unknown address gives an error — " + ("pass" if route("GET", "/nope") == "error 404: no such endpoint" else "fail"))
print("Test: unknown method gives an error — " + ("pass" if route("PATCH", "/records/" + SLUG) == "error 404: no such endpoint" else "fail"))
print("Test: routing is deterministic — " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(("|".join(results)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
